text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I was certain someone called for me around 
here, though.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The King, mishearing something...? 
Unthinkable... And yet, there is no one 
here—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, don't tell me the statue of the 
Three Goddesses called out to me?
